game.title: Fable Anniversary
game.blurb: Remaster of the fantasy action RPG Fable: The Lost Chapters, in which a young Hero grows up in Albion, from Lionhead Studios, released 2014-02-04 (Xbox 360; Fandom gives 12 September 2014 for PC). RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough for Fable and Fable: The Lost Chapters (CC BY-SA 4.0), grouped into stages.

chapters.title: Childhood and the Heroes' Guild
chapters.summary: A birthday gift for your sister, then training at the Guild until you graduate.

chapters.title: First Quests
chapters.summary: Your first jobs as a Hero: wasps, Orchard Farm and escorting traders.

chapters.title: The Seeress, the Archaeologist and the Balverine
chapters.summary: Looking for the Bandit Seeress and the Archaeologist, and a hunt under the full moon.

chapters.title: The Arena and Bargate Prison
chapters.summary: The Arena, the Graveyard Path, rescuing the Archaeologist and breaking out of prison.

chapters.title: Hook Coast and Jack of Blades
chapters.summary: The road to Hook Coast and the battle with Jack of Blades. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Lost Chapters
chapters.summary: The extra late-game quests added by The Lost Chapters, up to the final battle. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Minigames
chapters.summary: Optional quests, Fist Fighters, Card games, Coin Golf, archery, fishing contests and the Hero Dolls.

chapters.title: Demon Doors, Silver Keys and Life in Albion
chapters.summary: Demon Doors, Silver Keys, temples, houses, marriage, trading and roaming every region.

chapters.title: Growing Your Hero
chapters.summary: Strength, Skill and Will, spells, weapons, Renown, looks and fighting tricks.

collectibles.name: Hero, Their Health Is Low
collectibles.where: Heal a follower on an Escort Quest. No, not *that* kind of 'escort'.

collectibles.name: Ass Creed
collectibles.where: Whilst dressed as an Assassin, be silent but deadly.

collectibles.name: I Did This For A Cheevo
collectibles.where: Perform a headshot with a Crossbow whilst dressed as a woman wearing a beard and the Redhead Wig.

collectibles.name: There Is No Spoon
collectibles.where: Use the power of mind control on an enemy, and have them kill one of their allies.

collectibles.name: Combat, Evolved
collectibles.where: Use an "Ages of..." Potion with a combat multiplier of 20 or more.

collectibles.name: Out Of The Frying Pan…
collectibles.where: ...Into your face! Express your feelings through the medium of Frying Pan.

collectibles.name: As Quiet As A Whisper
collectibles.where: Defeat Whisper in a battle without losing any health.

collectibles.name: Feed The Troll
collectibles.where: Give a Troll a taste of its own medicine.

collectibles.name: The Summoner's Tail
collectibles.where: Summon a powerful creature to fight by your side.

collectibles.name: The Swinging Sword
collectibles.where: Hit 3 enemies simultaneously with a single flourish like you're a real swinger.

collectibles.name: You Are A Super Player
collectibles.where: Find all 30 silver keys. In unrelated news; the Fable Anniversary Strategy guide is available now!

collectibles.name: Fable Heroes
collectibles.where: The Bowerstone Teacher is on the lookout for Hero Dolls, help him find them!

collectibles.name: Education Rules The Nation
collectibles.where: The children in Bowerstone have no books to read! You don't want illiterate children, do you?

collectibles.name: Get It Off Your Chest
collectibles.where: Open your first Silver Key Chest to reveal the amazing surprise inside!

collectibles.name: Horde Mode
collectibles.where: Some weapons are Legendary, and we feel it's worth you collecting at least 10 of them.

collectibles.name: The Ultimate Warrior
collectibles.where: Treat yourself to a beard, haircut and tattoo, the 'Toupée And Tattoo Society' demands it.

collectibles.name: That's My Man!
collectibles.where: Level up a complete abilities tree, be it Strength, Skill or Will.

collectibles.name: I Am Legendary
collectibles.where: Earn enough Renown to be known in Albion as "Legendary".

collectibles.name: Are You Not Entertained?!
collectibles.where: Complete all 8 rounds of the Arena without taking a break.

collectibles.name: Great Balls Of Fire!
collectibles.where: Complete a truly heroic feat.

collectibles.name: From The Smallest Acorn
collectibles.where: Every tall oak tree needs to have its acorn moment, this is yours.

collectibles.name: The Graduation
collectibles.where: Graduate from the Heroes Guild to become a real Hero.

collectibles.name: Becoming A Man
collectibles.where: Pay a visit to Orchard Farm to see if you can be of help or hindrance.

collectibles.name: The Bloodline Part I
collectibles.where: Find the whereabouts of your sister, she's very important to the future of Albion.

collectibles.name: Under A Full Moon
collectibles.where: There's something going on in Knothole Glade under a full moon. Cliché? Never.

collectibles.name: Gladiator, Ready!
collectibles.where: Take on the might of everything that Albion has to offer. Well, almost everything…

collectibles.name: A Family Friend
collectibles.where: Rescue the Archaeologist, and find the secret entrance into Bargate Prison.

collectibles.name: Fishing In A Graveyard
collectibles.where: Go fishing and digging in a graveyard, as if it's a completely normal thing to do.

collectibles.name: The Bloodline Part II
collectibles.where: Now it's your mother that has gone missing, so it's time to find her too. Families, who needs 'em?

collectibles.name: There's Always A Lighthouse
collectibles.where: Would you kindly rid Albion of its greatest traitor.

collectibles.name: A Wild Jack Appears
collectibles.where: From the Void to the Guild, it's time to fight the big bad guy.

collectibles.name: Winter Is Coming
collectibles.where: Travel to the Northern Wastes, because it sounds like just the place you'd want to visit.

collectibles.name: Are You Listening To Me?
collectibles.where: Few things are smarter in Albion than a talking stone door, so imagine a door that knows the YMCA.

collectibles.name: Making Tough Decisions
collectibles.where: Behind the Bronze Gate lies your destiny, and all it needs is the death of your closest allies.

collectibles.name: (#SPOILERS)
collectibles.where: It's time to defeat the super awesome boss, the one you will see if you unlock this achievement.

collectibles.name: For Every Choice, An Achievement
collectibles.where: Become holier than Avo, or more evil than Skorm!

collectibles.name: But You're A Wizard, Hero
collectibles.where: Learn one of each spell type, or own one of each weapon type.

collectibles.name: That's A Real Lunker!
collectibles.where: Win 1st prize in the Fisherman's competition, or complete the boast for doing any quest naked.

collectibles.name: Fight Cluck
collectibles.where: Become the Fist Fighter's World Champion, or win the Chicken Hat in the Chicken Kicking Competition.

collectibles.name: Arthur or Robin?
collectibles.where: Pull the sword from the stone, or earn the top prize in the Archery Competition.

collectibles.name: Choosing My Religion
collectibles.where: Donate a total of 100,000 Gold to the Temple of Avo, or sacrifice 10 people to the Chapel of Skorm.

collectibles.name: Open Saysamemiddlefinger
collectibles.where: Open all the Demon Doors, or show a closed Demon Door what you think of it.

collectibles.name: Project Ego
collectibles.where: Show all available witnesses a trophy in the trophy mini-game, or decorate your home with a trophy.

collectibles.name: What Are Ya Sellin'?
collectibles.where: Make a profit from selling to a trader, or steal an item using the "Steal" expression from a trader.

collectibles.name: The Hero Of Time
collectibles.where: Eat a Moonfish in Bowerstone during the day, or a Golden Carrot at night.

collectibles.name: Beauty Or The Beast
collectibles.where: Reach the maximum of your chosen attractiveness; ugly or beautiful!

collectibles.name: Marital Relations
collectibles.where: Receive a gift from your spouse, or flirt with an admirer in front of your spouse.

collectibles.name: The Drinking Game
collectibles.where: Drink until you vomit, or 'help' a friendly villager get drunk.

collectibles.name: Definitely Not On Rails
collectibles.where: Visit every region (excluding Demon Doors), or increase your waistline so that you don't have to.

collectibles.name: Get Rich Or Die Tryin'
collectibles.where: Earn 10,000 Gold from property rental, or die.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: on StrategyWiki, "Fable Anniversary" redirects to "Fable: The Lost Chapters", whose page is at completion stage 3 and has only 5 subpages of its own ("Walkthrough", "Character Customization", "The Sick Child", "Book Collection", "Table of Contents"). Its contents page reuses the "Fable/" guide (the original game, also completion stage 3), which has 78 subpages, nearly all written quest, item and location pages (about 247,000 characters in all; for example "Locations" is about 55,000). The Lost Chapters walkthrough pages listed in the contents ("The Prophets of the Fire Heart", "The Ship of the Drowned", "The Oracle of Snowspire", "The Souls of Heroes", "The Final Battle" and others) are not created. Chapters follow the contents order, grouped into stages; titles and summaries are reworded and no text was copied. The guide is for Fable and The Lost Chapters, not written for the Anniversary edition, so differences in the remaster are not covered. fable.fandom.com answers the API under "Fable Anniversary", with about 49 linked articles; its summary calls the game a high-definition update of Fable: The Lost Chapters. Names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema for app 288470 has an empty game name; the store list confirms it as "Fable Anniversary". None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. The story achievements were placed by matching their wording to the StrategyWiki quest names and by falling unlock rates; the four after "A Wild Jack Appears" (Northern Wastes, the talking door, the Bronze Gate and the final boss) are placed in The Lost Chapters by that order, which is a judgement call. "As Quiet As A Whisper" and "Feed The Troll" sit with Growing Your Hero because their text names no quest. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
